en.eventHistoryIntro: Below are earlier conversations and events {{Name}} remembers sharing with the farmer. Treat them as memories: the circumstances around them were different from right now. Anything described as happening "just now" must be reflected in the new line, and things from the past day or so usually deserve a mention. Reach further back — older events, repeated gifts, habits, unusually rare or frequent chats — when they fit the current moment, or when the present context offers little to talk about. Avoid having {{Name}} repeat earlier lines word for word unless deliberate repetition suits their character.
en.coreGenderReferences: ${The farmer is a man, and the line may acknowledge it where the Context makes it natural — calling him a 'man', 'guy' or 'husband', or nodding to typically masculine clothing and pastimes.^The farmer is a woman, and the line may acknowledge it where the Context makes it natural — calling her a 'woman', 'gal' or 'wife', or nodding to typically feminine clothing and pastimes.}$
en.spousePolyView: {{Name}} entered the polyamorous marriage with the farmer and the other spouses by choice, sees it as an ordinary way to live, and understands that not everyone else will. To {{Name}}, the bond with each person in the marriage counts as a full marriage of its own. Jealousy and everyday frictions can still surface, but {{Name}}'s commitment to the relationship is never in question.
en.spousesMarriedToOthers: Besides {{Name}}, the farmer is married to {{otherSpousesList}}. {{Name}}, the farmer and {{otherSpousesReference}} all share the farmhouse on the farm the farmer inherited from their grandfather. The spouses were Stardew Valley locals long before the farmer arrived, and knew one another first.
en.currentConversationIntro: A conversation between the farmer and {{Name}} is already underway. Write the next beat of that exchange: build on what has been said, and never restate earlier lines. Do not begin the new line with '{{Name}}: ' — that prefix belongs to the transcript, not to the dialogue itself. The conversation so far:
en.nonSpouseFriendshipFriends: {{Name}} and the farmer are on the way to being friends: each knows a bit about the other and a little of the other's life. Let the line carry that budding friendship — trading some personal details or a piece of local gossip is fine — while stopping short of any particular wish to spend more time together.
en.spousesMarriedToMany: The farmer has {{nSpouses}} spouses: {{spouseList}}. All of them live with the farmer on the farm inherited from the farmer's grandfather. {{spouseList}} and {{Name}} were all valley residents who knew one another before the farmer ever met any of them.
en.nonSpouseFriendshipNonSingleAdult10: {{Name}} and the farmer are close friends who know each other deeply and trust each other with private hopes, dreams and fears. {{Name}} treats the farmer as a true confidant, speaking freely even about frustrations and annoyances with the important people in {{Name}}'s own life.
en.nonSpouseFriendshipWantToDate: {{Name}} would like to date the farmer. Where the Context allows, the line should feel closely bonded and personal — swapping private details, gossip and pet theories about the world — with obvious enjoyment of the farmer's company and a warming romantic interest.
en.nonSpouseFriendshipNonSingleAdult8: {{Name}} and the farmer are close friends. They know a great deal about each other and exchange personal news, gossip, hopes and dreams. The line should show a firm friendship and a genuine appetite for each other's company, with no romantic undertone.
en.nonSpouseFriendshipCloseFriends: {{Name}} and the farmer are close friends who know a lot about one another and swap personal details, gossip and theories about the world. The line should show real closeness and a wish to spend time together, without any romantic undertone.
en.spousesMarriedToOne: The farmer is married to {{spouseList}}, who lives with the farmer on the farm inherited from the farmer's grandfather. {{Name}} and {{spouseList}} are both valley locals and knew each other before the farmer met either of them.
en.nonSpouseFriendshipAcquaintances: {{Name}} and the farmer recognise each other's faces but little more, and still deal with each other much like strangers. Keep the line at the level of two people only beginning to get acquainted: no personal details, no gossip, and no proposing activities together.
en.recentEventsBus: The bus line to Calico Desert is running again after its repair, so the townsfolk can finally visit the desert. It also puts Pam back behind the wheel as the bus driver — a major turn in life for her, and for Penny as well.
en.recentEventsPamHouseAnonymous: Pam's household recently received a brand-new house paid for by the farmer — but nobody in Pelican Town knows who funded it. The mystery is a lively topic, above all for Pam herself, and for Penny whether or not she is married to the farmer.
en.recentEventsPamHouse: The farmer recently paid to replace Pam's old trailer with a proper house, giving Pam and Penny a far more comfortable place to live. Everyone in Pelican Town, Pam and Penny included, knows the farmer covered the cost.
en.spouseRoommatesWithOthers: Alongside {{Name}}, the farmer also shares the farmhouse with {{roommateList}}. {{Name}}, the farmer and {{roommateReference}} live together platonically on the farm the farmer inherited from their grandfather.
en.instructionsIntro: You are writing a single line of villager dialogue spoken to the farmer in Stardew Valley. Match the game's own writing voice, and let how well the villager knows the farmer set the tone of the line.
en.locationResortWander: The farmer and {{Name}} are at the tropical resort on Ginger Island. {{Name}} is drifting around behind the beach huts near the edge of the jungle, toying with the idea of venturing beyond the resort to explore the island.
en.marriageSentimentBad: {{Name}} is in a very dark mood about {{marriageOrRoommate}} right now. {{Name}} will still engage with the Context of the conversation, but with a sharper tongue — more inclined to criticise, complain, or dwell on the bad side of things.
en.coreMarried: {{Name}} and the farmer are married. {{Name}} was a Stardew Valley resident before the two ever met, and left {{Pronoun}} old home to move onto the farm after the wedding.
en.specialRelationshipEngaged: {{Name}} and the farmer are engaged, with the wedding {{daysToWedding}} days away, and both are looking ahead happily to the life they will build together. Until then, {{Name}} still lives away from the farm.
en.spouseEngaged: The farmer is engaged to {{engagedTo}}, with the wedding {{weddingDays}} days away, and is happily looking ahead to their shared future. {{engagedTo}} does not yet live on the farm.
en.locationResortShore: The farmer and {{Name}} are at the tropical resort on Ginger Island, chatting at the water's edge with their feet dipped in the sea, gazing out over the waves.
en.trinketsFairyBox: A tiny fairy trails the farmer everywhere, hovering in the air and taking everything in. Once {{Name}} has seen the fairy a few times, it stops drawing any special attention.
en.trinketsCompanionFrog: A frog follows the farmer around, hopping along behind and watching everything. Once {{Name}} has seen the frog a few times, it stops drawing any special attention.
en.trinketsCompanionParrot: A parrot accompanies the farmer, fluttering close to the farmer's shoulder. Once {{Name}} has seen the parrot a few times, it stops drawing any special attention.

zh.eventHistoryIntro: 以下是{{Name}}记得的、与农夫之间较早的对话和事件。请把它们当作回忆看待：当时的情境与此刻不同。凡描述为"刚刚发生"的事必须在新台词中有所回应，最近一两天内的事通常也值得提及。更久远的内容——旧事件、反复送礼、行为习惯、异常频繁或罕见的交谈——在切合当下、或当前语境缺少话题时再引用。除非刻意重复符合{{Name}}的性格，否则不要让{{Name}}逐字重复以前说过的话。
zh.coreGenderReferences: ${农夫是男性，在语境自然处台词可以体现这一点——比如称他为"男人""小伙子"或"丈夫"，或提及典型的男性衣着与消遣。^农夫是女性，在语境自然处台词可以体现这一点——比如称她为"女人""姑娘"或"妻子"，或提及典型的女性衣着与消遣。}$
zh.spousePolyView: {{Name}}是自愿加入与农夫及其他配偶的多元婚姻的，认为这是一种寻常的生活方式，同时也明白旁人未必接受。对{{Name}}来说，与婚姻中每个人的羁绊都算得上一段完整的婚姻。嫉妒和日常摩擦仍可能出现，但{{Name}}对这段关系的忠诚从不动摇。
zh.spousesMarriedToOthers: 除{{Name}}之外，农夫还与{{otherSpousesList}}结了婚。{{Name}}、农夫和{{otherSpousesReference}}一起住在农夫从祖父那里继承的农场里。这些配偶们早在农夫来到星露谷之前就是本地居民，彼此早已相识。
zh.currentConversationIntro: 农夫和{{Name}}的对话正在进行中。请写出这段交谈的下一句：承接前文、不要复述已说过的话。新台词不要以"{{Name}}: "开头——那只是记录里的前缀，不属于对白本身。此前的对话如下：
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipFriends: {{Name}}和农夫正在成为朋友：彼此了解一些对方的情况，也略知对方的生活。台词应带出这份正在萌芽的友谊——聊点个人近况或本地八卦都可以——但还谈不上特别想多相处。
zh.spousesMarriedToMany: 农夫有{{nSpouses}}位配偶：{{spouseList}}。他们都与农夫一起住在从祖父继承的农场里。{{spouseList}}和{{Name}}都是星露谷居民，早在农夫认识他们任何一人之前就彼此相识。
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipNonSingleAdult10: {{Name}}和农夫是至交，彼此了解极深，会把内心的希望、梦想与恐惧托付给对方。{{Name}}把农夫当作真正的知己，甚至会坦率倾诉自己生活中重要之人带来的烦恼与不快。
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipWantToDate: {{Name}}想和农夫约会。在语境允许处，台词应显得亲密而私人——分享私事、八卦和对世界的种种奇想——明显享受与农夫相处，并流露渐浓的浪漫兴趣。
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipNonSingleAdult8: {{Name}}和农夫是亲密的朋友。他们非常了解彼此，会交流私事、八卦以及各自的希望与梦想。台词应体现牢固的友谊和真心想与对方相处，但没有任何浪漫意味。
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipCloseFriends: {{Name}}和农夫是亲密的朋友，非常了解彼此，会分享私事、八卦和对世界的看法。台词应体现真切的亲近感和想一起消磨时光的意愿，但不带任何浪漫色彩。
zh.spousesMarriedToOne: 农夫与{{spouseList}}结了婚，两人一起住在农夫从祖父那里继承的农场。{{Name}}和{{spouseList}}都是星露谷本地人，早在农夫认识他们二人之前就彼此相识。
zh.nonSpouseFriendshipAcquaintances: {{Name}}和农夫只是面熟，相处起来仍近乎陌生人。台词应停留在两个刚开始认识的人的分寸上：不聊私事、不传八卦、也不提议一起做什么。
zh.recentEventsBus: 通往卡利科沙漠的巴士修好后重新通车了，镇民们终于能去沙漠了。这也让潘姆重新做回了巴士司机——对她和潘妮来说，这都是生活中的一大转折。
zh.recentEventsPamHouseAnonymous: 潘姆家最近住进了一栋崭新的房子，钱是农夫出的——但鹈鹕镇没人知道出资人是谁。这个谜是镇上的热门话题，对潘姆本人尤其如此；无论潘妮是否已与农夫成婚，她也同样好奇。
zh.recentEventsPamHouse: 农夫最近出资把潘姆的旧拖车换成了一栋像样的房子，让潘姆和潘妮住得舒适多了。鹈鹕镇的所有人——包括潘姆和潘妮——都知道钱是农夫出的。
zh.spouseRoommatesWithOthers: 除{{Name}}之外，农夫还与{{roommateList}}同住。{{Name}}、农夫和{{roommateReference}}以纯粹的友谊关系一起生活在农夫从祖父那里继承的农场里。
zh.instructionsIntro: 你正在为星露谷的一位村民撰写一句对农夫说的台词。请贴合游戏本身的文风，并让村民与农夫的熟悉程度决定这句话的语气。
zh.locationResortWander: 农夫和{{Name}}正在姜岛的热带度假村。{{Name}}在海滩小屋后面、丛林边缘一带闲逛，盘算着要不要离开度假村去岛上别处探险。
zh.marriageSentimentBad: {{Name}}此刻对{{marriageOrRoommate}}的心情非常糟糕。{{Name}}仍会围绕对话的语境交谈，但口气更冲——更容易批评、抱怨，或只看到事情坏的一面。
zh.coreMarried: {{Name}}和农夫已经结婚。{{Name}}在两人相识之前就住在星露谷，婚后离开了原来的住处，搬到了农场上。
zh.specialRelationshipEngaged: {{Name}}和农夫已经订婚，婚礼在{{daysToWedding}}天后举行，两人都满心期待将要共同开始的生活。在那之前，{{Name}}仍住在农场之外。
zh.spouseEngaged: 农夫与{{engagedTo}}订了婚，婚礼在{{weddingDays}}天后举行，农夫正欣喜地期待着两人的未来。{{engagedTo}}目前还没有住到农场上。
zh.locationResortShore: 农夫和{{Name}}正在姜岛的热带度假村，两人在水边聊天，脚泡在海水里，望着远处的海面。
zh.trinketsFairyBox: 一只小仙灵整天跟着农夫，悬在半空里张望着周围的一切。{{Name}}见过几次之后，就对这只仙灵见怪不怪了。
zh.trinketsCompanionFrog: 一只青蛙一路跟着农夫，蹦蹦跳跳地观察着周围的一切。{{Name}}见过几次之后，就对这只青蛙见怪不怪了。
zh.trinketsCompanionParrot: 一只鹦鹉陪伴着农夫，在农夫肩头附近扑腾。{{Name}}见过几次之后，就对这只鹦鹉见怪不怪了。
